personal_token.label: API token
personal_token.where: coda.io/account - API settings, Generate API token. Coda lets you restrict a token to a single doc; do that rather than issuing an unrestricted one.
notes: An unrestricted Coda token inherits everything the person can see, which for most accounts is every doc they have ever been shared on.
Coda has no third-party OAuth flow for the REST API; tokens are the supported mechanism.
Tokens are unscoped by default and inherit the generating user's permissions - the restriction has to be applied when the token is made.

upsert_rows.notes: Writes into a doc. Draft rather than send: visible to collaborators but not an outbound message.
